# Setup Instructions

<!-- provenance -->
> **AI-written interpretation** of the code at commit `1a80fc8`, based on the extracted facts (`integrations.md`, `change-impact.md`, `architecture.md`, `data-model.md`, `graph.json`) and sampled source. Verify details against the code.


This document outlines the steps to set up and run the `mlightcad` project. Follow these instructions to get the development environment ready, configure necessary components, and run the project and its tests.

## Prerequisites

Before setting up the project, ensure you have the following installed on your system:

- **Node.js**: Version 24 or higher
- **pnpm**: Version 10 or higher
- **Git**: To clone the repository

You can verify the installations by running the following commands:

```bash
node -v
pnpm -v
git --version
```

## Installation

1. **Clone the Repository**:
   
   Clone the project repository from GitHub:
   
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/mlightcad/cad-viewer
   cd cad-viewer
   ```

2. **Install Dependencies**:
   
   Use `pnpm` to install all necessary dependencies:
   
   ```bash
   pnpm install
   ```

3. **Setup Workspace**:

   The project uses workspaces defined in the `package.json`. Ensure you are in the root directory of the project to initialize workspaces correctly.

## Configuration

The project configuration mainly utilizes the `package.json` file. No additional environment variables are specified in the configuration files provided.

## Running the Project

To run the project in development mode, use the following commands:

- **Development Mode**:
  
  Run the main development setup:
  
  ```bash
  pnpm dev
  ```
  
  This will start the development server for the `cad-viewer-example` package.
  
- **Alternative Development Modes**:
  
  The project supports multiple development modes for different examples:
  
  ```bash
  pnpm dev:simple
  pnpm dev:html-converter
  pnpm dev:diff
  ```

## Building the Project

To build the project for production, execute:

```bash
pnpm build
```

This will compile the TypeScript and bundle the JavaScript using the specified configurations.

## Running Tests

The project uses Jest for testing. To run all tests, use:

```bash
pnpm test
```

For end-to-end testing of the `cad-viewer-example` package, run:

```bash
pnpm test:e2e
```

## Additional Commands

- **Lint and Format Code**:
  
  Use the following commands to lint and format the codebase:
  
  ```bash
  pnpm lint
  pnpm format
  ```

- **Generate Documentation**:
  
  To build and preview the documentation, use:
  
  ```bash
  pnpm docs:all
  pnpm docs:preview
  ```

These commands will build the documentation using VitePress and Typedoc.

## Conclusion

Following these steps will set up your development environment for the `mlightcad` project. Ensure all commands are executed from the project's root directory for correct workspace resolution.
